events.title: GCTechSpace Open Night Tour
events.description: A community-run tour of a local makerspace where attendees can see 3D printers, electronics, and DIY technology projects in action. It is an ideal environment to meet local hobbyists, engineers, and creators.

events.title: Speak with Confidence & Competence (Palm Beach Currumbin Toastmasters)
events.source: Gold Coast to Tweed Speakers & Leaders
events.description: A friendly, non-corporate setting to practice public speaking and active listening through structured exercises and impromptu debates. Perfect for those looking to build communication skills in a supportive local community.

events.title: Soy Candle Making Workshop – Gold Coast
events.description: A guided hands-on session focusing on the craft of candle making using soy wax and essential oils. Provides a tactile creative experience in a small, intimate class setting.

events.title: Life Drawing
events.description: An untutored life drawing session held in an art gallery, allowing artists and hobbyists to practice figure drawing in a communal, creative atmosphere. Suitable for all skill levels interested in human anatomy and art.

events.title: Saturday Board Games Night
events.description: A regular social gathering for enthusiasts of modern strategy and tabletop board games. It fosters a relaxed, intellectual environment where strangers naturally connect over complex gameplay.

events.title: Let There Be Light — art exhibition
events.location: The Hive Gallery Currumbin, Currumbin Waters
events.description: A local art exhibition showcasing contemporary works, offering a quiet space to explore visual culture and engage with regional artists.
